dogecoin.text:
👉34% of HOOD's cryptocurrency transaction-based revenue was attributable to transactions in Dogecoin.

Doge has proved to be a big earner for exchanges, perhaps why 
@coinbase
 added it earlier this month.

However, my attention if mainly on #bitcoin.

How do they make it possible to earn interest (and very high) on Dogecoin.

My best guess, is they lend it to people/institutions which use it to short DOGE.

So while you think your making money with your interest, in reality you're funding people shorting it. 

LMAO.
